To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we developed a 94GHz phased-array IC that achieves 106mW of TX power consumption per element with a +6.4 dBm per-element TX output power, 91mW of RX power consumption per element, and a RX element NF of 12.6 dB.
we have demonstrated the first integrated 94GHz phased-array transceiver with integrated LO generation, which has achieved improved per-element power efficiency compared to state-of-the-art arrays.

we have demonstrated the first 94GHz 8×8 phased-array with integrated LO generation, flip-chip antenna integration, and beam steering over a wide scan angle range, and we have achieved the best per-element power consumption of any published 94GHz phased-array.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the design, implementation, and characterization of a fully integrated 4×4 phased array for 94GHz FMCW radar, including a 47-94GHz LO generation scheme and a flip-chip antenna module with four TX/RX antennas.
the development of high performance millimeter-wave (MMW) integrated circuits for applications in radar, imaging, and communications.
the design of high performance, low power, low cost, and highly-integrated phased-array transceivers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

this paper presents the first demonstration of a complete 94GHz 2-D phased array with 4×4 TX-RX elements in 130nm SiGebased BiCMOS, and the first demonstration of an integrated LO generation scheme for 94GHz phased arrays in SiGe BiCMOs.
this thesis demonstrates a fully integrated 94GHz phased-array transceiver that has been successfully integrated into a flip-chip antenna array module.
this work demonstrates the first 4×4 phased-array transceiver IC at 94GHz for FMCW radars with integrated LO generation, flip chip integration, and TX/RX beam steering.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this is the first 94GHz SiGe BiCMOs phased array with integrated LO and packaged with a flip chip antenna.

we have demonstrated a complete phased array system for 94GHz radar applications with the following features: (1) A 94GHz 2×4 phased-array transceiver IC with integrated LO generation, flip chip antenna package, and 20° beam steering.

we have demonstrated a 94GHz phased array transceiver with a 4x4 antenna array, integrated LO generation, and flip chip antenna module, and that the power consumption of this transceiver is the lowest reported in literature for a 94GHz array.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of flip chip technology and integrated LO generation can enable a significant reduction in the power consumption and size of a 94GHz phased-array for Fmcw radar.
the integration of LO generation and the use of a flip chip antenna package enables the use of a low-power 130nm Si/SiGe BiCMOS process to build high-performance 94GHz phased-array radar systems.
the integration of LO generation, LO buffers, and phase shifters in an array is possible, and can be done without sacrificing performance, and without adding significant power consumption.
